verdict.rationale: Deepgram documents a per-request retention control: requests join the Model Improvement Program and are retained by default, but `mip_opt_out=true` means they are not retained. It also offers EU and other regional endpoints for data residency. A disclosure line could be spoken via InjectAgentMessage or the system prompt, but the docs show no call-recording or consent feature, so the founder must build consent handling themselves. Missing for 10: per-call recording on/off controls, a consent-capture or disclosure workflow, configurable retention periods beyond opt-out, and independent corroboration.
